summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to cultivate personal well-being and meaningful relationships by relinquishing the need for external validation and control. She teaches that by choosing to own our daily actions and viewing our roles through a lens of self-worth independent of others' behaviors, we can better serve Hashem and foster healthier connections with our children.
questions: How can I stop feeling stressed when I try to make events perfect?
How do I handle the feeling that my children are not connecting with me enough?
How can I feel like I am accomplishing something meaningful during a busy day?
Why does my child seem to pull away when I try to get closer to them?
How can I maintain a positive view of my children even when their behavior is difficult?
